evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Establishes a mandatory ongoing operational cadence ('from now on').

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Formulates an absolute, identity-level axiom defining the organizational standard for operational readiness.
Records the established recurring cadence as a structured operational rule.
Records the definitive assignment of ownership for the operational process.
